children: Vertiv Holdings said it has entered into a deal to buy King Environmental Services, a Europe-based provider of fluid management, commissioning and load-testing services for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers and other applications.
Financial terms weren't disclosed, and aren't expected to be material to Vertiv's financial results.

The company said the acquisition is expected to expand its global thermal-management services capabilities into Europe, Middle East and Africa, and advance its strategy to support customers across the thermal chain.

Vertiv said its purchase of King Environmental will help it provide more comprehensive support as customers deploy and operate complex AI and high-density infrastructure with greater reliability, efficiency and accountability.
King Environmental is headquartered near Dublin, Ireland, and serves customers across the EMEA region.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
